text.note: contrast on #0b0f19: s2 15.0:1, s3 10.9:1, s4 7.8:1. Never use #64748b or darker for text.

assets.mark: logo/rook-tilt.svg — tilted rook, vector, transparent; primary brand mark (v3)
assets.markDark: logo/rook-tilt-dark.svg — same mark on its own dark field
assets.favicon: logo/favicon/ — favicon.svg, favicon.ico, 16/32/48 PNG, apple-touch-icon, icon-192/512
assets.legacyWordmark: am-logo.png / am-logo-white*.png — older rook; keep only where a raster lockup is unavoidable
assets.note: sits on dark backgrounds; keep transparent padding; do not place on busy imagery. The SVG master is ~435 KB; use it at nav/hero sizes, use the PNGs for email and documents.

convention: uppercase + letter-spaced JetBrains Mono for eyebrow labels and metric captions; Space Grotesk for headlines; Inter for body

cdn.rule: Reference these hosted paths; do not download and embed the Drive masters. Always pin a tag.
